text: 3how does it look like this in the editor [Image #1] but then like this in game [Image #2] ??
resolution: Explained and fixed the editor/game stair mismatch. The editor preview had moved to the improved full-width multi-step stairs, but the compiled no-V8 game geometry still had its own stale STAIR_VISUAL_STEPS path, so the game baked chunky four-block stairs. Stair visual decomposition now lives in shared placed-build tuning and both pieceMeshes.tsx and compile/worldGeometry.ts consume it; compile/worldGeometry.test.ts pins the compiled step count, full width, tread depth, and top height.
